subject: general
question: If a man lifts 1 kg of load to the height of 2.5 m from the ground, then assuming acceleration due to gravity is 10 m/sec², magnitude of the work done by the man is ______.
solution:
**Given:**

Mass (m) = 1 kg

Height (h) = 2.5 m

Acceleration due to gravity (g) = 10 m/s²

**Concept:**

The work done by a force is given by the formula:

W = m × g × h

Where:

 
• W = Work done
 
• m = Mass of the object
 
• g = Acceleration due to gravity
 
• h = Height to which the object is lifted

 

**Calculation:**

⇒ W = 1 × 10 × 2.5

⇒ W = 25 joules

**∴ The magnitude of the work done by the man is 25 joules.**
